name: Tofu Akuri with Tomato and Coriander
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, drained and crumbled
steps: Press tofu between paper towels for 5 minutes and crumble roughly.
Heat oil in a skillet. Add cumin, onion, ginger and chilli; cook 2 minutes.
Add tomato, turmeric and ground coriander. Cook until tomato softens.
Fold in tofu and cook 4–5 minutes, stirring gently until hot and lightly dry.
Finish with coriander and lemon. Serve with whole-grain toast or roti.
note: A plant-based adaptation of the softly scrambled Parsi-style akuri idea; no eggs or dairy are used.
